summary: Sourcey documentation site for the labstack/echo Go package (github.com/labstack/echo/v5), generated from the pinned source commit 59aacddc4a13904b8a80a76f1ec838c495b5feca (20 Nov 2026, release v5.4.7, MIT). Built with Sourcey 3.9.5 using the godoc adapter in snapshot mode: a godoc.json snapshot of the root package (424 public API symbols) plus an overview, a quickstart, and five guides condensed from the project's own README at the pinned commit. The static site (10 pages) is staged for the docs PR to labstack/echox and will publish at https://echo.labstack.com/sourcey/ after merge; the deploy pipeline (deploy.yml + astro.config.mjs site + live robots.txt 200) is verified, but the URL is NOT live yet.
